rules: Every numbered exhibit is a single-panel data chart or schematic except the four that are plates: Figure 1 (two photographs), Figure 4 (three bar panels), Figure 11 (two doughnuts) and Figure 12 (four small multiples). panel_count is 1 on the other nine figures and 1 on all three tables, which record their grid instead [geometry.panel_count] [geometry.panel_layout].

No exhibit in the paper is three-dimensional and none carries a colour scale: three_d is 'no' and colorbar is false on all thirteen figure rows, including the three glossy bars and the two doughnuts, whose depth is only a drop shadow [geometry.three_d] [geometry.colorbar].

Shared axes appear only where panels are small multiples of the same quantity, and here that is nowhere: Figure 4 repeats its x axis on all three panels and Figure 12 gives each of its four panels its own x and y, so shared_axes is false on every row [geometry.shared_axes].

Legend placement splits by chart type rather than by figure: the three bar/line charts of the modelling chapters put their legend under the plot (Figures 7, 10 and 12), the two doughnuts put one under each circle, and the eight diagrammatic figures carry no legend at all because their labels sit inside the scene [geometry.legend].

Captions are always below the artwork and always a single sentence: figures run 5 to 15 words and tables carry no caption at all, being introduced by a sentence in the body instead [caption.position] [caption.words] [caption.sentences].

Table grids are booktabs horizontals with one vertical rule after the stub, no shading, no merged cells and no diagonal header; the only grid that decimal-aligns is the ratio table under 9.3.3 [table.rule_style] [table.zebra] [table.merged_cells] [table.decimal_aligned].

Mention is overwhelmingly deictic: only 10 of the 13 figure rows are ever named by number, and the two appendix tables and the p16 matrix carry no number at all, so the prose points at them positionally ('the table below', 'the charts are shown in Figure 11') [mention.lead_pattern] [mention.count].
